Subject: Re: Fwd: Upcoming renewal: ContainerOps registry addons (image scanning + OCI caching)

Jasmine — pulled numbers from Buildkite and our registry telemetry. Summary (attachment: ci-license-report.csv):
- Buildkite agent concurrency: avg 420 active agents/day across org; peak 720 (spikes for release days).
- Licenses currently purchased: 1,000 agents. Utilization: ~42% avg, ~72% peak.
- CI pipelines using OCI caching: ~18 teams (approx 240 repos). Of those, 9 teams rely heavily (cache hits > 60%), 9 teams have marginal benefit (hits < 30%).
- Image scan volume: ~14k images/month (includes dev snapshots).

Recommendations:
1) Reallocate 200 agent licenses from dev-tools sandbox org to prod-critical orgs; request Buildkite allow license re-mapping at renewal instead of net-new purchase. This saves ~$28k/year at current rates.
2) Disable OCI caching for non-critical teams (9 teams) to reduce addon tier. We estimate removing those teams would drop effective caching usage by ~35%.
3) Keep image scanning at current level but ask for scan tier discount if we commit to 12 months.

I'll attach the csv (ci-license-report.csv) with per-team counts. Happy to walk through numbers on a quick call.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Negotiation stance & procurement plan for ContainerOps / Buildkite items

Team — thanks for the numbers, Dev. Proposed procurement approach:
- Primary ask to ContainerOps: price per image-scan tier reduction (target: 15% off list) if we commit 12 months and agree to a 30-day trial extension for OCI caching on one additional team.
- Primary ask to Buildkite: license reallocation and a 6-month price hold for agent licenses while we validate reallocation. If they resist, ask for a step-down pricing schedule tied to utilization thresholds.
- Contingency: If ContainerOps won't provide concession, explore a partial migration of non-critical repos to self-hosted scanning (scheduled scans) — estimated infra delta is low but requires 2 weeks of ops work.

Action items:
- Jasmine: send consolidated ask to Samir and include Buildkite renewals with our utilization ask. Please attach the MAP-draft.docx (mutual action plan) and CI report.
- Dev: prepare a short one-pager on ops impact if caching is disabled for marginal teams.
- Karthik: confirm list of critical teams that must keep caching.
- Marissa (procurement): I'll prepare the initial SOW language and negotiation bullets; target to have internal approval by 2026-07-12.

Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: samir@containerops.com, renewals@buildkite.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal coordination: consolidated ask + next steps (ContainerOps / Buildkite)

Samir / Buildkite renewals — looping you both to align on a consolidated renewal approach for ContainerOps addons and Buildkite agent licenses. Summary of our internal analysis attached (ci-license-report.csv) and a draft mutual action plan (MAP-draft.docx). Key asks: 

1) ContainerOps
- 12-month term with a 15% list discount on image scanning tier if we commit to current scan volume.
- Allow us a 30-day trial extension to enable one additional team to validate OCI caching benefits before we finalize the addon scope.
- Provide a revised quote and SOW showing per-feature line items (image scanning, OCI caching) and cancellation/scale-down terms.

2) Buildkite
- Allow reallocation of 200 agent licenses at renewal rather than forcing a net-new seat purchase.
- Maintain current pricing for 6 months while we monitor utilization; if utilization remains below 60% average we expect to renegotiate to a lower tier.
- Provide a short note on whether you support a step-down pricing schedule tied to utilization thresholds.

Next steps / timeline
- We aim to finalize internal approval by 2026-07-12 and have a signed renewal by 2026-08-10. Please send revised quotes/answers to the bullets above by 2026-07-09 so procurement can review.

Attachments: ci-license-report.csv; MAP-draft.docx

Thanks — happy to set a joint call if helpful.

Best,
